title: Single Source of Truth, Cache Freshness, and TTL Check

questions.prompt: What should the UI read after a successful remote refresh?
questions.answer: The updated Room source of truth
questions.explanation: One local authority keeps online and offline identity and ordering coherent.
options: The updated Room source of truth

questions.prompt: Expired TTL means cached content must be deleted before attempting refresh.
questions.explanation: Stale content may remain useful offline while refresh is attempted.

questions.prompt: What makes time-based cache tests deterministic?
questions.explanation: Tests can set freshness boundaries without waiting on wall time.
